newsitem.title: USA: Saudi Arabia cuts Dec crude to Europe 15-30 cts/bl.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia cuts Dec crude to Europe 15-30 cts/bl.

text.p: Saudi Arabia reduced term crude oil prices to European customers for December by 15-30 cents a barrel, U.S. trade sources said.
The biggest drop in price was for Berri Extra Light, which fell 30 cents to Dated Brent minus $1.00 a barrel.
Arab Light was cut 25 cents to Dated Brent minus $1.85 a barrel, and Arab Medium was cut by 20 cents to Dated Brent minus $3.05 a barrel.
The price for Arab Heavy was dropped 15 cents to Dated Brent minus $3.60 a barrel, traders said.
